title: Noujawaan Akbare Man aarame jaan akbare man
body:
Nowjawan Akbareman
Arame Jaan Akbereman
Mirasad Khushk Labe Shate Furatak Bareman
Seyalanima Kunai Chasmaye Chasme Tareman
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaswate Omere Tuta In Khame Ferozanamon
Laliya Warda Berun
Giti Az Nil Aza Karda Sia Majzohman
Nowjawan Akbareman
<<DIVIDER>>
Tabad Dagh Tu Ayi Zadah Azadad Nehad
Natawan Bardo Ziyad
Az Azal Kash Nami Zadah Mera Madareman
